premise.claim: RBG workloads increasingly need placement constraints such as multi-node instance packing and prefill/decode co-location; KEP-473 turns those topology intents into a scheduler-independent PlacementPlan compiled for Volcano.
premise.evidence: Base branch 0821cb5b has no TopologyConstraint type, no Volcano networkTopology compilation, and no HyperNode reads (grep over pkg/, api/, internal/ returns nothing). Feature premise holds: the capability does not exist on base. See results/premise-base-grep.out.

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$(setup-envtest use -p path 1.34.x || true)" go test ./test/envtest/testcase/topology/ -v -ginkgo.json-report=$GINKGO_REPORT

liveNote: L3 needs a real Volcano cluster with HyperNodes: deploy the PR controller with --scheduler-name=volcano, create an RBG+CoordinatedPolicy from test/e2e/testcase/v1alpha2/topology_scheduling.go, and check the rendered PodGroup carries networkTopology/subGroupPolicy and covered pods actually land in-domain (e2e spec 'renders a topology constraint and schedules covered pods with Volcano').
